note: Commercially the best-qualified prospect in the batch and clinically the worst. He runs his own coaching business, dismissed $6,000 outright — 'the money I don't think will be a big deal at all' — against a recent fifty-thousand-dollar coaching purchase, and is lean rather than deconditioned. But the two criteria that describe the starting point both fail, and fail in the opposite direction from the usual. Health is not the neglected area of his life; it is the central project of it, managed by a functional medicine practitioner with full blood work, a prescribed diet, a supplement protocol and a parallel neuroplasticity programme. And he is not going from good to great — he is managing lifelong autoimmune disease, SIBO, painful bladder syndrome and multiple structural presentations. This is the pattern already recorded against Tyron Giuliani: the stated ICP screens on success, income and starting point and contains no clinical criterion at all, so a prospect it scores as commercially ideal is the one most in need of being screened out or screened first.
